question: What is the Superlative of Late?
explanation: 'Late'-এর সময়সূচক Comparative হলো 'Later' এবং Superlative হলো 'Latest' (অবস্থান নির্দেশক রূপ হলো Latter - Last)।

question: What is the superlative degree of 'shy'?
explanation: 'shy' (লাজুক) Adjective-এর Comparative হলো 'shier/shyer' এবং Superlative রূপ হলো 'shiest/shyest' ।

question: What is the superlative of 'Good'?
explanation: 'Good' Adjective-এর Degrees of Comparison হলো: Positive: Good, Comparative: Better, Superlative: Best।

question: What is the superlative degree of 'bad'?
explanation: Bad এর comparative ও superlative degree হলো যথাক্রমে worse এবং worst

question: 'least' কোনটির superlative degree?
explanation: 'Little'-এর Comparative রূপ হলো 'Less' এবং Superlative রূপ হলো 'Least' (Little - Less - Least)।

question: কোনটি positive degree?
explanation: 'much' হলো Positive degree; এর Comparative রূপ হলো 'more' এবং Superlative রূপ হলো 'most'।

question: কোনটি superlative degree?
explanation: Better হলো Good এর comparative Degree।Less হলো Little এর comparative Degree।Further হলো Forth এর comparative Degree।Worst হলো Bad এর superlative Degree।

question: কোন শব্দটি Comparative degree- এর উদাহরণ নয়?
explanation: 'Highest' হলো Superlative degree (High - Higher - Highest); অপরপক্ষে Upper, Less, Worse হলো Comparative degree।

question: 'Very few boys are as industrious as Zaman.' (Make it comparative)
options: Zaman is more industrious than most other boys.
Zaman is more industrious than all other boys.
Zaman is the most industrious boy in the class.
Zaman is as industrious as other boys.
explanation: 'Very few' যুক্ত Positive degree-কে Comparative করতে Subject-এর পর Verb + Comparative form + than most other + plural noun বসে: 'Zaman is more industrious than most other boys.'।
correct_answer: Zaman is more industrious than most other boys.

question: 'Alam is the best boy in the class'? (Make it comparative)
options: Alam is better than any other boy in the class
Alam is better than most other boys in the class
Alam is better than all other boys in the class
Other boy in the class are better than Alam
explanation: Superlative degree (the best)-কে Comparative করার নিয়ম: Subject + verb + better + than any other + singular noun: 'Alam is better than any other boy in the class'।
correct_answer: Alam is better than any other boy in the class

question: He was one of the worst men in the world. (Make Positive)
options: Very few men in the world were so bad as he
Very few men in the world was so bad as he
Very few men in the world was so bad so he
Very few man in the world were as bad as he
explanation:
Superlative: 'He was one of the worst men in the world.'
• 'One of the' যুক্ত Superlative-কে Positive করার নিয়ম:
$$	ext{Very few} + 	ext{Plural noun} + 	ext{Plural verb} + 	ext{so/as} + 	ext{Positive degree (bad)} + 	ext{as he}$$
• সঠিক Positive: 'Very few men in the world were so bad as he.'
correct_answer: Very few men in the world were so bad as he

question: It is more than honest. (Make it 'Positive')
options: Honesty is not as much as it
Honesty is as much as it
Honesty are not as much as it
Honesty is less much as it
explanation: 'It is more than honest'-এর রূপান্তরে 'Honesty is not as much as it' ইতিবাচক অর্থকে সমার্থকভাবে প্রকাশ করে।
correct_answer: Honesty is not as much as it

question: 'A string of pearls was not so bright as her teeth.' (Make it comparative)
options: Her teeth was more brighter than a string of pearls.
Her teeth were brighter than a string of pearls.
A string of pearls was brighter than her teeth.
A string of pearls were very bright than her teeth.
explanation: 'not so bright as'-যুক্ত বাক্যকে Comparative করতে শেষ পদ 'her teeth' (বহুবচন হওয়ায় were) প্রথমে এনে brighter than বসে: 'Her teeth were brighter than a string of pearls.'।
correct_answer: Her teeth were brighter than a string of pearls.

question: Dhaka is becoming one of the — cities in Asia.
explanation: 'one of the'-এর পরে Adjective-এর Superlative degree বসে; 'busy'-এর Superlative রূপ হলো 'busiest'।

question: He is taller than —.
explanation: Comparative conjunction 'than'-এর পরে Pronoun-এর Subjective রূপ বসে (He is taller than I [am]); সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে 'I' বসবে।

question: It was — expensive than I thought.
explanation: 'than'-এর পূর্বে Comparative degree বসে; একাধিক syllable বিশিষ্ট Adjective 'expensive'-এর Comparative রূপ 'more expensive'।

question: Of the four books, the red one is the —.
explanation: দুইয়ের অধিক (চারটি বইয়ের) মধ্যে তুলনা এবং পূর্বে 'the' থাকায় Adjective-এর Superlative degree 'cheapest' বসবে।

question: Rajshahi is — sugar growing areas in Bangladesh.
explanation: বহুবচনবাচক 'sugar growing areas'-এর পূর্বে নির্দিষ্ট করে গঠন অনুযায়ী 'one of the largest' বসে।

question: The chain was — than was thought.
explanation: বাক্যে 'than' থাকায় comparative degree ব্যবহৃত হবে; 'strong'-এর comparative রূপ হলো 'stronger'।

question: The headmaster is the — person in the village.
explanation: নির্দিষ্ট Article 'the'-এর পর Adjective-এর Superlative degree বসে; 'wise'-এর Superlative রূপ হলো 'wisest'।

question: The greater the demand, — the price.
explanation: আনুপাতিক বৃদ্ধি বা হ্রাস ('যতই... ততই') বোঝাতে 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' নিয়ম অনুসৃত হয়: 'The greater the demand, the higher the price'।

question: I though that — was the last one.
explanation: সবগুলোর মধ্যে সবচেয়ে সুন্দর নির্দেশ করতে Superlative-এর সাথে 'the prettiest one of all' গঠনটি সম্পূর্ণ নির্ভুল।

question: She is beautiful but she is — her mother.
explanation: বৈপরীত্যমূলক অর্থ বোঝাতে এবং মায়ের সাথে তুলনা করতে নেতিবাচক গঠনে 'not so beautiful as' সঠিক।
